ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 24-F in
the area bound by:

West 95" Street; South LaSalle Street; the alley next south of and parallel to West 95"
Street; and a line 27.48 feet west of and parallel to South LaSalle Street

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Anthony A. Beale
Alderman, 9 Ward

Common Address:
135 W. 95th Street
